Deblina
Dey

Postdoctoral Fellow · Mathematics · IISER Bhopal

I am Deblina Dey, a postdoctoral fellow in Mathematics at IISER Bhopal, working with Dr. Sankhaneel Bisui.

My doctoral research at IIT Madras was supervised by Prof. A. V. Jayanthan and Prof. Sarang Sharad Sane and supported by a Prime Minister’s Research Fellowship (PMRF).

My research interests lie in commutative algebra and algebraic combinatorics, with a particular focus on binomial edge ideals, parity binomial edge ideals, and their algebraic invariants.
